title: How to Add Blink to Cursor: Full-Stack Infrastructure in One Command
summary: Add Blink to Cursor in 2 commands: npx skills add blink-new/blink-plugin + blink login. Get database, auth, and hosting inside your agent — no Vercel, no Supabase.
body_markdown: Vercel + Supabase are two separate platforms you wire together yourself. Blink Cloud is one platform your Cursor agent controls directly via MCP — the database, auth, hosting, storage, and backend are all provisioned by tool calls, not by you logging into dashboards. No configuration between services. No API keys to copy-paste. One bill instead of six.
